svg.title: How a KnobMix works
svg.desc: Two decks play the songs. KnobShift listens for the voice, the drums and the breaks. The old singer finishes the last line while the new song's beats slide in underneath with its voice held back, the beats lock together, the old song slows and fades, and the new verse lands just as the old song leaves.

g.text: The old singer finishes the line. The new verse lands on the beat.
Just as the old song leaves
